_comment: THE GATE — generic profile. For any language not otherwise profiled: osv-scanner SCA (all ecosystems), gitleaks, multi-language CodeQL, detected test command, zizmor. A repo is never ungated.
name: github-ci-security-generic
description: Universal fallback gate for any language: osv-scanner SCA, gitleaks secrets, multi-language CodeQL, detected test command, zizmor.

variables.name: codeql_on
variables.description: Include the CodeQL job (analyzes whatever languages are present)

notes: Contexts: sca, secrets, codeql, tests, zizmor. The tests job detects a runnable test command (npm test / go test / pytest); nothing detected = skipped. osv-scanner covers npm, PyPI, Go, Maven, Cargo, RubyGems, composer and more.
